_comment: ARES STATION - endless siege. The first engagement that does not list its waves. It declares an 'endless' block and core/database.gd expands it into a concrete wave list at load, so the simulation never learns that endless mode exists: _begin_wave still reads waves[i], wave_count() still answers, the debrief still works, and a replay of an endless run is a replay of a fixed list.
_why_expanded_at_load: The alternative was a generator running inside the tick, which would have been a second source of truth about what wave 40 contains - and the first thing to disagree with a replay. Expanded once, up front, there is only ever one wave list.
_why_the_archetypes_cycle: Cycled by index, not drawn at random. 'Wave 12 is always a Breakthrough' is something a player can learn, plan an opening around, and be punished for forgetting. A shuffled order can only ever be survived, and it makes the whole mode a reaction test.
_starting_integrity: The station's hull. Eight lanes converge here and early leaks are not a failure state, they are the cost of conceding an approach on purpose - which is the whole opening decision. At the corridor's 100 the mode ends on wave two before that decision exists.

endless._waves: 14, matching the campaign's act lengths, with the Titan on wave 5 and the Harbinger on 10. It was authored at 40 and the balance probe could not win it: the scripted policy hit the deployment limit (48/48 built) and still drowned, because per-lane duty cycle means a turret here does about a sixth of a corridor turret's work while wave mass compounds. Probed at 14: WIN, 1369 of 2600 hull left, 33 built - leaky and held, which is what a siege should feel like. Longer sieges want the probe taught to buy ground; see post-launch.md.
endless._count_growth: 1.115 per wave compounding: wave 40 sends about 70x the bodies of wave 1. Steep, but the bounty and the interest ramp with it, and every fifth wave hands over a boss bounty worth several waves of income.
endless._spawn_interval: Intervals contract as counts grow, so a late wave is not merely longer - it arrives together. The floor stops the contraction from collapsing into a single-tick dump that no rate of fire could ever answer.
endless._boss_every: Every fifth wave, and the two bosses alternate, so the first Harbinger lands on wave 10 with a Titan already survived on wave 5. Bosses arrive ON TOP of their wave rather than instead of it - a boss alone is a damage check with nothing protecting it.
endless._archetypes: Five shapes, cycling. Each one asks a different question of the same board: can you kill a lot of small things, can you kill one big thing, can you kill the thing keeping the others alive, and can you do any of it while jammed.
